text: `'b' - 'a'` is now a Core.IntLiteral; the char redesign had made it i32. It changed for consistency with other literals (it converts implicitly to u8 or i64) and to fix the prelude layering, a circular dependency on Core.Int(32) in int.carbon. char - char still produces i32 (proposals/p007314-charliteral-difference-should-be-an-intliteral.md).
